rules.tested: At least one test of the material family has stated oxygen and pressure inside the bin, at that gravity level.
rules.nearby: No test in the bin, but a test of the family sits in an adjacent oxygen or pressure bin (one step, diagonals included) at the same gravity level, or a test's stated range overlaps the bin.
rules.none: Neither. Gravity is never 'nearby': a test at another gravity level does not count.
rules.placement: A test whose oxygen or pressure is not stated, or is only bounded on one side, is listed but not placed.
